title: Goldspirit Farm
specs: Training by US Eventing Association Certified Level II Instructor Susan Friend Le-Tourneur
Lesson horses are show-ready and well cared for with vet, chiropractor, acupuncturist, and dentist check-ups
Trainer Susan Friend Le-Tourneur is a USDF Bronze Medalist and international two-star event competitor
Helmets must be worn at all times when riding a horse
Riders under 18 must wear approved ASTM/SEI helmet with chinstrap properly attached
Supervision required when jumping; no jumping alone on property
No open toed shoes allowed in horse areas
Liability release and rider form must be signed before handling or riding a horse

includes: Feeding of oat and/or alfalfa hay morning and evening
Automatic waterers, salt blocks, and fly sprayers in all stalls
Training with certified instructor Susan Friend Le-Tourneur
gap: Age minimum not stated for lessons or boarding
blurb: Guests receive training and lessons in eventing, jumping, and dressage with certified instructor Susan Friend Le-Tourneur. The farm offers boarding, training packages, lesson horses, and showing services. Additional services include grooming, braiding, and tack sales.
tags: Boarding 12' x 12' Box Stall with training package
extraNote: Membership required with a nominal one-time fee · No smoking on property except in car in parking lot or off-site · Rules for safety and well-being of horses and riders must be followed
